audit.whatIsWrong: content.early says 'He answers with Fired Up (Q) slows' — Fired Up! is Milio's passive (P), an on-hit burn empower, not a Q, and it doesn't apply the slow; the slow/knockback comes from Ultra Mega Fire Kick (Q).
audit.why: Kit confirms P = Fired Up! (on-hit empower) and Q = Ultra Mega Fire Kick (knockback + slow). The sentence conflates the two abilities into one mislabeled cast.
audit.corrected: He answers with Fired Up! (P) empowered autos and Ultra Mega Fire Kick (Q) slows to whittle you, so don't facetank the poke.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.late says 'His Ultra Mega Fire Kick cleanses your Tempered Fate stun' — the cleanse belongs to Breath of Life (R), not Q. The page's own win[6]/spikes[1] text gets this right elsewhere, so 'late' contradicts the rest of the matchup.
audit.why: Kit: R = Breath of Life, 'heal and remove crowd control effects from allies'. Q = Ultra Mega Fire Kick, a knockback/slow with no cleanse text.
audit.corrected: This is where Milio edges ahead. His Breath of Life (R) cleanses your Tempered Fate stun, and Ultra Mega Fire Kick (Q) knocks your engage away on the follow-up, while his global-tempo shielding makes his carry very hard to lock down. Play for early tempo and cross-map roams rather than a scaling war.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Breath of Life as matchup-defining but gives no cooldown number (lint: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Breath of Life (R) is 160/145/130s — stating it tells the reader exactly how long they have after Milio burns it.
audit.corrected: Breath of Life (R) is 160s at rank 1, down to 130 at rank 3 — the team-wide cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain, so force it early and engage after. Keep Magical Journey (E) banked for their best play. Your own ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
